name: Grosser Aussen-Flohmarkt Wetzikon

our_current.de: Grosser Flohmarkt im Freien bei der Eishalle in Wetzikon, mit rund 10'000 Quadratmetern Verkaufsfläche. Privatleute bringen alles mit: Möbel, Haushaltswaren, Kleidung, Hobbysachen und grössere Posten, die in keinen Stand in der Innenstadt passen würden. Regional, gemächlich und gross genug für einen ganzen Vormittag.
our_current.fr: Un grand marché aux puces en plein air près de la patinoire de Wetzikon, sur environ 10 000 mètres carrés. Les particuliers y proposent de tout : meubles, articles ménagers, vêtements, objets de loisirs et gros lots qui ne trouveraient pas leur place sur un stand en ville. Une ambiance régionale, un rythme tranquille, et assez d'espace pour y passer une vraie matinée.
our_current.it: Un grande mercatino all'aperto vicino alla pista di ghiaccio di Wetzikon, con circa 10.000 metri quadrati di bancarelle. I privati portano un po' di tutto: mobili, casalinghi, vestiti, oggetti per il tempo libero e roba ingombrante che non starebbe su una bancarella in centro. Un mercato dal carattere regionale, da girare con calma, e davvero abbastanza grande da passarci una mattinata intera.
our_current.en: A large outdoor flea market near the ice rink in Wetzikon, with roughly 10,000 square metres of selling space. Private sellers bring the full range — furniture, household goods, clothing, hobby items and large-volume lots that wouldn't fit in a city-centre stall. Regional in feel, unhurried in pace, and genuinely large enough to spend a proper morning in.

For families specifically looking for children's items, a trip to the old town is worthwhile even without another event.

Private residents set up stalls across the district — just follow the coloured balloons. This year's edition includes a special Lysbüchel extension, with the car-free Lothringerstrasse leading into the newly developed Lysbüchel area packed with stalls, games, and food. The bring-and-take point is at St. Johanns-Park by the Badhüsli on Elsässerstrasse. One of the bigger and more festive editions in the Quartierflohmi series. One of 17 neighbourhood flea markets organised across Basel by Verein Stadtprojekt throughout the season.

The organiser's 2026 page (a Saturday in August, 10-17) mentions no Lysbüchel extension, only the car-free Fatiostrasse and parts of Jung- and Lothringerstrasse, and its menu lists 18 neighbourhoods.
